This environment consists of a centralized software platform used by gyms or fitness centers to track their fitness machines and equipment.  
Each machine has a unique identifier and associated records such as condition, location, maintenance history, and usage statistics.  
Staff use this system to quickly retrieve information about equipment status, ensuring timely maintenance and optimal facility operation.

   - Update its condition to operational.
   - Return it to its original location (Eastside Cardio Gym).
   - Reflect a post-repair test run in its usage statistics by increasing usage_count by 1, increasing usage_hours by 0.2, and setting last_used to 2024-06-06.

   - Return it to its original location (Wellness Annex).
   - Reflect a post-service test ride in its usage statistics by increasing usage_count by 1, increasing usage_hours by 0.1, and setting last_used to 2024-06-06.

5) Update the Wellness Annex location description to append: “Includes refreshed bikes as of 2024-06.”

function.description:

function.description:
